info.title: Das Keyboard 5Q Universal API
info.description: Control Das Keyboard 5Q Q Cloud keyboard signals, including creating, listing, reading, coloring, and deleting signal records for 5Q devices.

post.description: Creates a signal in Das Keyboard 5Q.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

message.example: Lucky you! Apple stock is greater than $500

zoneId.description: Keyboard zone targeted by the signal, such as KEY_Q, 74, or 2,2.

color.description: Signal color as a hex value beginning with # and followed by 3 or 6 hexadecimal digits.

pid.description: PID of the target Das Keyboard device, such as DK5QPID.

isArchived.description: Whether the signal is archived. Das Keyboard notes this is ignored on localhost.

isRead.description: Whether the signal is marked as read. Das Keyboard notes this is ignored on localhost.

clientName.description: Name of the client creating the signal, such as Zapier or Local Node Script.

isMuted.description: Whether the signal is muted in the API response.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
